# ARC Raiders Skill Tree Builder

> ARC Raiders Skill Tree Builder is a free, community-created web planner for allocating skills across Conditioning, Mobility, and Survival. It includes an AI Build Advisor that can generate personalized builds or review a player's current allocation.

This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Embark Studios. Skill and guide content is community maintained; verify current in-game values after game updates.

Last updated: 2026-07-23

## Core Tools

- [Interactive Skill Tree Builder](https://arcraiderskill.com/): Plan skill ranks, inspect prerequisites, track branch totals, share builds, and capture screenshots.
- [AI Build Advisor](https://arcraiderskill.com/): Generate a build or review a current build using point budget, squad size, focus, playstyle, and optional priorities. Results include allocations, explanations, tradeoffs, warnings, and proposed changes.
- [AI See](https://arcraiderskill.com/ai-see.html): Machine-readable product capabilities, current skill-tree structure, data notes, and citation routes.
- [Wiki](https://arcraiderskill.com/wiki.html): Skill-tree concepts and reference content.

## Skill Tree Reference

- 45 nodes total: 15 Conditioning, 15 Mobility, and 15 Survival.
- Each node has a stable ID, name, description, maximum rank, prerequisite node IDs, and optional branch point requirement.
- The standard interactive planner tracks a 75-point allocation.
- AI Advisor budgets currently available in the interface: 76, 81, 86, and 91 points.
- AI-generated allocations are validated against node IDs, maximum ranks, parent paths, branch requirements, and the selected budget before display.
